verdict.rationale: Netlify's integrations directory shows starter templates for common use cases (Remix+Supabase, Angular bare-bones project, Clerk B2C auth template), indicating template-based quick deployment exists. However, none of the evidence explicitly describes a 'one-click deploy' button/flow or a dedicated templates gallery UI, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the one-click experience is present. Missing for 10: explicit one-click 'Deploy to Netlify' button documentation, a dedicated templates marketplace/gallery, and community corroboration of the one-click flow working.
